# CalcHub

> CalcHub is a free online calculator directory offering 150+ instant-result calculators across math, finance, health, physics, statistics, construction, and everyday life categories. No signup required. No ads. No paywalls.

## What CalcHub Is

CalcHub provides free, accurate, browser-based calculators built on professionally-validated formulas. Every calculator runs entirely in the browser — no server round-trips, no data collection. Results are instant.

The site covers 10 calculator categories with 149+ tools and 35+ educational articles.

## Calculator Categories

- **Math** (26 calculators): Percentage, square root, quadratic formula, trigonometry, fractions, logarithms, area, volume, and more
- **Finance** (27 calculators): Compound interest, mortgage, loan payments, VAT, ROI, salary converter, retirement, debt payoff, and more
- **Health** (14 calculators): BMI, calorie/TDEE, body fat, ideal weight, water intake, heart rate zones, pregnancy due date, ovulation, and more
- **Physics** (9 calculators): Kinetic energy, speed/distance/time, free fall, force (F=ma), density, buoyancy, and more
- **Statistics** (8 calculators): Mean/median/mode, standard deviation, probability, z-score, combinations/permutations, and more
- **Construction** (20 calculators): Square footage, paint, concrete, tiles, carpet, drywall, roofing, pool volume, and more
- **Conversions** (7 calculators): Length, weight, temperature, speed, volume, data storage, area
- **Unit Converters** (14 tools): km to miles, inches to cm, grams to ml, clothing sizes, roman numerals, and more
- **Everyday Life** (16 calculators): Age, date difference, fuel cost, sleep, caffeine, recipe scaler, walking pace, and more
- **Comparisons** (11 calculators): Rent vs buy, lease vs buy car, petrol vs diesel, electric vs petrol, inflation, solar panel payback, heat pump vs gas boiler, home energy savings, and more

## Key Calculators

- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://calchub.dpdns.org/calc/compound-interest): Calculates future value with principal, rate, compounding frequency, and time. Shows year-by-year growth.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://calchub.dpdns.org/calc/mortgage): Monthly payment, total interest, and amortization based on loan amount, rate, and term.
- [BMI Calculator](https://calchub.dpdns.org/calc/bmi): Body Mass Index using WHO classification (underweight/normal/overweight/obese) for adults.
- [TDEE / Calorie Calculator](https://calchub.dpdns.org/calc/tdee): Total Daily Energy Expenditure using Mifflin-St Jeor formula with activity multipliers.
- [Loan Calculator](https://calchub.dpdns.org/calc/loan-payment): Monthly payment and total interest for any fixed-rate loan.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://calchub.dpdns.org/calc/percentage): Find X% of Y, what % X is of Y, and after increase/decrease.
- [ROI Calculator](https://calchub.dpdns.org/calc/roi): Return on investment as percentage and net gain.
- [Sleep Calculator](https://calchub.dpdns.org/calc/sleep-calculator)
- [Solar Panel Payback Calculator](https://calchub.dpdns.org/calc/solar-payback): Calculate payback period, 25-year ROI, and net savings from a solar installation based on system cost, output, and electricity rates.
- [Heat Pump vs Gas Boiler Calculator](https://calchub.dpdns.org/calc/heat-pump-savings): Compare annual running costs, payback period on installation premium, and 20-year net savings.
- [Home Energy Savings Calculator](https://calchub.dpdns.org/calc/home-energy-audit): Estimate savings from insulation, double glazing, LED lighting, and smart thermostat upgrades with individual payback periods.: Optimal wake/sleep times based on 90-minute sleep cycles.
- [Age Calculator](https://calchub.dpdns.org/calc/age): Exact age in years, months, and days from any birthdate.
- [VAT Calculator](https://calchub.dpdns.org/calc/vat-calc): Add or remove VAT at any rate.

## Educational Articles

CalcHub publishes practical guides explaining the concepts behind its calculators, including:
- Sleep cycles and optimal sleep timing
- Compound interest and the Rule of 72
- BMI limitations and alternatives
- Budgeting strategies (50/30/20 method)
- Mortgage amortization explained

## Technical Details

- Single-page application with clean URL routing (/calc/[id])
- All calculations run client-side in JavaScript
- Mobile-responsive design
- No cookies required for core functionality
- Schema.org structured data (WebApplication, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList) on all calculator pages
